vend.definition: v sell or offer for sale from place to place
vend.translation: v. 出售, 从事贩卖

venda.translation: n. 文达语；文达共和国

vendable.definition: s fit to be offered for sale
vendable.translation:
a. 可销售的, 可被普遍接受的
n. 可销售物

vendace.definition:
n. A European lake whitefish (Coregonus Willughbii, or C.
   Vandesius) native of certain lakes in Scotland and England. It is
   regarded as a delicate food fish. Called also vendis.

vendage.translation: 收获葡萄, 葡萄的收获期

vended.translation: v. 出售（尤指土地等财产）( vend的过去式和过去分词 ); （尤指在公共场所）贩卖; 发表（意见, 言论）; 声明

vendee.translation:
n. 买方, 买主
[经] 买主

vendemiaire.translation: [网络] 葡月；葡萄月；葡月号

vender.definition: n someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
vender.translation:
n. 小贩, 卖主, 自动售货机
[计] 售主, 自动售货机, 厂家

vendetta.definition: n. a feud in which members of the opposing parties murder each other
vendetta.translation:
n. 族间仇杀, 世仇, 宿怨
[法] 血仇, 近亲复仇, 世仇

vendettas.definition: n. a feud in which members of the opposing parties murder each other
vendettas.translation: n. 家族世仇( vendetta的复数形式 ); 族间仇杀; 长期争斗; 积怨

vendeuse.translation: <法>n.(尤指时装店的) 女售货员, 女店员

vendibility.definition: n. The quality or state of being vendible, or salable.
vendibility.translation:
n. 可销售性
[经] 能销, 能卖

vendible.definition: s fit to be offered for sale
vendible.translation:
a. 可销售的
n. 有销路的物品, 可销售物

vending.definition: n. the act of selling goods for a living

vendition.definition: n the act of selling goods for a living

vendor.definition: n someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
vendor.translation:
n. 小贩, 卖主, 自动售货机
[计] 计算机销售商

vendor performance.translation: [经] 卖主交割(货)执行情况

vendors.definition: n. someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
vendors.translation: n. 摊贩( vendor的复数形式 ); 小贩; （房屋等的）卖主; 卖方

vends.translation: v. 出售（尤指土地等财产）( vend的第三人称单数 ); （尤指在公共场所）贩卖; 发表（意见, 言论）; 声明

vendue.definition: n the public sale of something to the highest bidder
vendue.translation:
n. 公开拍卖, 拍卖
[法] 公开拍卖, 竞卖
